visual.general_description: Color swimlane-style timeline: a treatment bar of mepolizumab and tezepelumab blocks above a line chart of eosinophil counts, with prednisolone dose segments and steroid-burst markers.
visual.detailed_description: A white-background figure with a horizontal treatment bar across the top. A long outlined white block labelled "Mepo" fills the left part of the bar, followed by a hatched block labelled "Teze", then five narrower hatched blocks that alternate with white blocks to the right end. The legend at right shows a white square for Mepolizumab and a hatched square for Tezepelumab. Below the bar, a row of double-headed arrows spans consecutive intervals labelled "PSL 10 (mg/day)" followed, left to right, by 7.5, 6, 5, 10, 7.5, 10, 7.5, 10, 15, 10, 7.5 and 5, with a grey dotted arrow at the far right ending at 4. The main plot has a y axis titled Eosinophils (/μL) with ticks from 0 to 500 in steps of 50 and an x axis titled Month, with tick labels running from X-75 through X-3, then X, then X+1 through X+15; the labels X-69 and X are printed in bold. A single blue line with round markers begins near 350 at the first two points, dips to about 270, returns to about 300, then falls to about 40 and stays between 0 and about 60 until X, with intermittent zeros. After X the line rises to about 155 at X+3 and then oscillates between 0 and about 125. Three grey downward triangles sit above the axis, two close together near the X-15 and X-14 labels under one "Steroid burst" label and one between the X-3 and X labels under a second "Steroid burst" label. No patient name, identifier or panel letter is visible.

caption_claims.value: Caption states the timeline begins with biologic initiation, shows lack of sustained control with mepolizumab monotherapy, then tezepelumab introduction and alternation of the two agents at four-week intervals, with steroid bursts and relapses indicated.

evidence.quote:
Figure 1
Swimlane-style timeline illustrating the clinical course and treatment transitions in a patient with eosinophilic granulomatosis with polyangiitis (EGPA) and eosinophilic otitis media (EOM). The figure displays the temporal relationship between clinical events, oral prednisolone (PSL) dosing, peripheral eosinophil counts, and the administration of biologics (mepolizumab and tezepelumab). The timeline begins with the initiation of biologic therapy and highlights the lack of sustained control with mepolizumab monotherapy, followed by the introduction of tezepelumab and the subsequent alternation of the two agents at four-week intervals. Steroid bursts and clinical relapses are also indicated, providing a visual summary of disease activity and therapeutic response.

clinical_significance.statement: Authors present the timeline as a visual summary of disease activity and therapeutic response, with mepolizumab monotherapy lacking sustained control before tezepelumab and its alternation with mepolizumab.

visual.general_description: Three-column figure with two rows: CT images (A), otoscopic photographs (B) and audiograms (C), each shown before alternation (top) and 6 months after alternation began (bottom) according to the printed row labels in the first column.
visual.detailed_description: The figure is a 2 by 3 arrangement. A grey label column at far left prints "Before Alternation" for the top row and "6 months after alternation began" for the bottom row. Column (A) holds grayscale CT images each with a black arrowhead, column (B) holds round colour otoscopic photographs, and column (C) holds printed audiogram grids with circles, crosses and bracket marks plotted against 125 to 8000 (Hz). Panel letters (A), (B) and (C) appear in black boxes at the top left of each column. No names, dates or identifiers are visible.

panels.general_description: Two stacked grayscale cross-sectional CT images with a grey label cell at left ("Before Alternation" above, "6 months after alternation began" below) and a black arrowhead in each image; panel letter (A) printed at top left.
panels.detailed_description: Panel (A) is a two-row panel. A grey cell at the left of each row carries white text: "Before Alternation" in the top row and "6 months after alternation began" in the bottom row. Each row shows a grayscale cross-sectional CT image with bright bone and a visible honeycomb pattern of small bright partitions at right. A black triangular arrowhead points to a region beside a rounded bony structure. In the top image the area at the arrowhead is mid-gray; in the bottom image a larger black region lies beside the arrowhead. The images show faint horizontal line texture. No side marker, scale bar, name or number is visible.

panels.general_description: Two stacked audiogram charts, one above the other, plotting circles joined by a solid line and crosses joined by a dotted line against frequency in Hz; panel letter (C) printed at top left.
panels.detailed_description: Panel (C) shows two printed audiogram grids with frequency labels 125, 250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000 and 8000 (Hz) along the bottom and decibel tick labels down the left. The top grid ticks run from 0 to 130; the bottom grid ticks run from -20 to 130. Each grid has open circles joined by a solid grey line and crosses joined by a dotted line, plus scattered bracket marks and a small dot or tail near the highest-frequency cross. In the top grid the circles lie at roughly 15 to 35 dB across frequencies, while the crosses descend from about 35 dB at 125 Hz to about 100 dB at 4000 Hz and about 95 dB at 8000 Hz. In the bottom grid the circles lie at roughly 10 to 50 dB, with the right-most at 8000 Hz, while the crosses run from about 30 to 35 dB at 125 to 1000 Hz then fall to about 60 dB at 2000 Hz and about 100 dB at 4000 and 8000 Hz. No name, date, legend or identifier is visible.
